title: Junta node work bound
statement: Let $n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $P\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a set of coordinates, and let $\delta\in(0,1/2]$ be a failure parameter. Set $M$ equal to the restricted sample count for $P,k,\delta$. The node work bound is the sum of the junta restriction sample count at degree parameter $k$ with inputs $M$ and half the failure parameter, the corresponding junta restriction sample-work bound, and the node analysis work bound for $P,k,\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$
caveat: The referenced sample-count, sample-work, and analysis-work constructions are not defined in the supplied material.
